The main takeaway from our work is that
we have developed a transgenic mouse line expressing the Cre recomombinase under the control of a BAC containing the CamKII α gene.
the BAC‐based approach for gene targeting in the CNS is an efficient and powerful strategy for generating conditional transgenic mice for the analysis of brain function and development.
